definitions.explanation: The closing part of a chapter in a book, especially the summaries or practice problems placed there in textbooks and study guides.

examples.japanese: {章末|しょうまつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are problems at the end of the chapter.

examples.japanese: {章末|しょうまつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦まとめ→まとめ：10506_matome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read the summary at the end of the chapter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{各|かく}→各〜：00449_kaku⟧{章末|しょうまつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}{問題|もんだい}→練習問題：21219_renshuumondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{参考書|さんこうしょ}→参考書：05142_sankousho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I chose a study guide with practice problems at the end of each chapter.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{章|しょう}→章：03768_shou⟧ (chapter) + {末|まつ} (end). Refers to the tail end of a chapter, most often in the context of textbook material placed there.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {章末|しょうまつ}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧: end-of-chapter problems
- {章末|しょうまつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦まとめ→まとめ：10506_matome⟧: chapter-end summary

The opposite is ⟦{章|しょう}→章：03768_shou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{初|はじ}め→初め：02931_hajime⟧ (the beginning of a chapter).
